# tshapedconsultant.com — outline

Site: https://tshapedconsultant.com/
Author: Andrés Lage Freire, Responsible AI Architect. Based in Madrid · Working remotely across EMEA.
Practice: AI Governance Engineering — controls, accountability and evidence across the AI lifecycle.

## Pages

### Home — https://tshapedconsultant.com/
- Executable AI governance for regulated and agentic systems
- DGOM™: PLAN → BUILD → DEPLOY → MONITOR, designed and governed by Andrés Lage Freire
- Service ladder: AI Governance Snapshot (€2,495 launch price, first two contracted projects, one week), AI Governance Blueprint (€6,500, diagnosis plus architecture and control design), fractional governance support
- Technical delivery capacity for law firms and advisory partners (referral, co-delivery, white-label support)
- Priced diagnostic offers remain on the homepage
- Case studies: BBVA platform and AI strategy (PDF); Responsible AI framework for resume–job matching (PDF)
- Reference implementations: HR Copilot — Technical Governance Implementation (TGI v1), Enterprise AI Risk Console (live demo: https://enterprise-ai-risk.onrender.com), RAG Security Validator (live demo: https://rag-security-validator-demo.onrender.com), Enterprise Data Analyst Agent, Porto Seguro Compliance Hub (EIPD walkthrough videos on the project card; anonymized Kaggle dataset, not a live insurance book), Automated Red Teaming for Safety-Critical AI
- Contact: https://tshapedconsultant.com/#diagnostic

### Whitepaper — https://tshapedconsultant.com/whitepaper
Current English PDF: Unified Edition v5.4, 23 pages, 25 November 2026. https://tshapedconsultant.com/Probabilistic-Models-Require-Deterministic-Governance.pdf
The illustrative policy printed there is policies/dualkey_illustrative.rego, checked with OPA 1.22.4. The verifier, authorization coordinator and PEP are described, not demonstrated end to end. HR Copilot is a documented demonstration. Sector reference architectures are not production deployments. Commercial results are not measured.
Previous English PDF (16 November 2026): https://tshapedconsultant.com/archive/Probabilistic-Models-Require-Deterministic-Governance-2026-11-16.pdf
Spanish PDF: 30-page edition of 16 November 2026. The unified Spanish edition is not published. https://tshapedconsultant.com/Gobernanza-Determinista-IA.pdf
The on-site essay is the earlier long edition and can be read without an email.
Dédalo™ Executive Brief, a separate two-page summary, not the unified edition: https://tshapedconsultant.com/Dedalo-Executive-Brief.pdf

### Hybrid profiles — https://tshapedconsultant.com/hybrid-profiles
Why Hybrid Profiles May Have an Advantage in the Age of AI Agents (7 September 2026). Fundamentals, specialist depth, cross-domain judgment and AI-agent leverage.

### Agentic AI and Montesquieu — https://tshapedconsultant.com/agentic-ai-montesquieu
Why autonomous systems need separation of powers (15 July 2026). Runtime Checks & Balances; EU AI Act Art. 14 and DORA.

### Dual-Key Protocol — https://tshapedconsultant.com/governance/dual-key-protocol
Keeps AI recommendations separate from execution authority. An independent policy decides when two human keys are required. The entry offer is the one-week AI Governance Snapshot (from €2,495): a diagnosis, not a design, implementation or certification. Reference architectures are designs to validate per deployment, not verified production deployments. The illustrative Rego snippet is exercised by the repository OPA allow and deny tests. It is not a production authorization policy.

### Dédalo™ — https://tshapedconsultant.com/dedalo
Short hub, not a second Dual-Key page. Dédalo™ is the architecture, DGOM™ is PLAN → BUILD → DEPLOY → MONITOR, and Dual-Key is the execution-authority pattern for consequential actions. Anthropic’s Working with AI study (Wilmers, Massenkoff and McCrory, 23 November 2026; 66 interviews, 58 US customers, not a random sample) is cited as directional evidence. It is not a causal ROI estimate and not an Anthropic endorsement. Spanish: https://tshapedconsultant.com/es/dedalo

### Beyond task automation — https://tshapedconsultant.com/insights/ai-value-workflow-redesign
Open essay in English and Spanish (same slug). It keeps the study separate from the governance interpretation. The appendix PDF was not used as a source for a correlation coefficient. Spanish: https://tshapedconsultant.com/es/insights/ai-value-workflow-redesign

### EU AI Act mapping — https://tshapedconsultant.com/governance/eu-ai-act-mapping
Which obligations apply by role and system, executable controls, and the evidence pack an auditor would inspect. References: Porto Seguro Compliance Hub; Enterprise AI Risk.
